decisions.approved_rule: File and hierarchy traversal must express an unbounded depth as **`max_depth: unlimited`**, not `null` or a magic negative integer. Bounded depth is an integer of at least zero (`0` searches the starting directory only); OVAL `max_depth=-1` converts to `unlimited`. The editor may offer this explicitly documented choice but the scanner must not infer it from omission. Historical 0.1–0.3 grammars remain unchanged.

decisions.approved_rule: For **newly authored** file Objects, the editor suggests **`filesystem: local`** and writes it explicitly into YAML, even when the UI hides it. This is an **authoring preference**, not an implicit scanner default. **Source conversion is different:** OVAL 5.12.3 omitted `recurse_file_system` means effective `all`, which must serialize as **`filesystem: all`**; explicit OVAL `local` remains `local`, and `defined` becomes NG `same`. Do not normalize source-effective `all` to `local` or conflate filesystem scope with recursion depth/direction.
